222-527-1322-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1322-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1278-2034-3327-4508.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-2034-3327-4508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-2034-3327-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2292-4871-8168.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3188-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
3188-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

643-728-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-728-4302.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3773-3899-6972--112.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
3773-3899-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2107-4644-7791.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Sunastian Falconer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Sunastian Falconer.
Repeat.

2275-3532-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-3185-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Evernight Shade enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Evernight Shade from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Evernight Shade enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 7, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
413-3185-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 5 instead.

1920-2060-3490-3891.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1920-2060-3490-3891.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Elrond triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

443-2438-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

628-5147-7214.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

147-6797-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-6797-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-6797-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

1444-1494-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1444-1494-4613-7152.description:
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1444-1494-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Elvish Fury. Elvish Fury is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

1648-3129-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1648-3129-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa of Shadowed Boughs
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

585-3767-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
585-3767-3918-7013.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

3446-3532-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3446-3532-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control

515-1114-1636.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Wrenn and Realmbreaker.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

147-6797-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-6797-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-6797-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

1491-2464-6702.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1491-2464-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Activate Kilo by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5111-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

856-4050-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

509-1267-2003-5056.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each even-numbered extra turn
509-1267-2003-5056.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2003-5056.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Neurok Transmuter by paying {U}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat steps 6 through 9 one additional time.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two time counters on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

4050-4222-5969-5970.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Marina.
4050-4222-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
4050-4222-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Devils, adding {U}{U}.
When the Devils die, they trigger, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

971-3008-3048-4186.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it
Scurry Oak has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
971-3008-3048-4186.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak and two charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Scurry Oak triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Pentad Prism twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

678-4050-4151-4871.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
678-4050-4151-4871.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing two Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}.
When the Phyrexian Mites die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{G}.
Repeat.

509-1912-2585.notablePrerequisites: Idris does not have summoning sickness.
509-1912-2585.description:
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2231-4809-5220.description:
Cast Shifting Wall either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Shifting Wall on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2257-2957-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2257-2957-4508.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, giving Reckless Fireweaver the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Imagecrafter, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.
